answer: Give each agent a passport tied to its TPM chip, verified once in person at a registered kiosk. The kiosk records the chip fingerprint and stores a signed certificate that expires after 90 days, and renewal repeats the same check. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 10,000 chips at 40 dollars each and 10,000 kiosk visits in 30 days, costing over 400,000 dollars. Like a sonnet that fails when one line breaks meter, a quill signature fails unless chip and certificate match. The oasis stays clean because each fake identity must be bought and checked by hand.
